cards.headline: Your daily India news will land here
cards.body: Every morning at 6 AM a small script reads Indian news feeds (PIB, The Hindu, Indian Express, LiveMint, DD News), picks the most important stories and turns each into a card like this one: a short explainer, why it matters and one fact worth remembering.
cards.why_it_matters: Two minutes of these a day adds up to real current-affairs knowledge, without the doomscroll.
cards.key_fact: Sample card – real news arrives in phase 2

cards.headline: Tap 'New to me' and it comes back as a quiz
cards.body: Cards you mark as new return as quick quizzes after 1, 3 and 7 days. Answer correctly and the card moves to the next interval; get it wrong and the schedule restarts. That's spaced repetition, the most reliable way to make facts stick.
cards.why_it_matters: Reading once is forgettable. Recalling a fact a few times over a week is what moves it into long-term memory.
